sources.entry: Sosse - Selenium based search engine and crawler with offline archiving. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Python/Docker

summary.name: Sosse
summary.one_liner: Sosse is a Selenium-based search engine and web crawler that archives pages offline.
use_cases: crawling and indexing a list of URLs
monitoring sites via feeds and webhooks
summary.what_it_does: The page is the documentation index for Sosse. It lists sections covering installation (Debian, pip, Docker, Docker-compose), an administration interface with a crawl queue, crawlers, analytics, collections, Atom and RSS feeds, documents, tags, domains, cookies, webhooks, mime plugins, excluded URLs, and permissions. It also lists external search engine shortcuts, a profile, offline browsing of archived pages, and a REST API. The listing describes it as a Selenium-based search engine and crawler with offline archiving, licensed AGPL-3.0 and written in Python with Docker support. The page text itself contains no detailed feature specifications beyond section titles.
notable: Selenium-based crawling with offline archiving of pages
Self-hosted install via Debian package, pip, Docker or Docker-compose
Includes a REST API, RSS/Atom feeds and webhooks
caveats: Page text is only a documentation index; no limitations are stated
